item.title: Bangladesh A reaches final defeating Pakistan
item.description: Bangladesh A stormed into the final of the Women’s Asia Cup Rising Star tournament with a commanding 54 run victory over Pakistan in the semifinal on Friday.Batting first, Bangladesh posted 110 for 8 in their allotted overs. In reply, Pakistan were bundled out for just 56, undone by a disciplined spin attack from the hosts.Bangladesh will face India in the final on February 22.After losing the toss and being sent in to bat, Bangladesh struggled early as their top order faltered. item.title: Bangladesh marks 74th Language Movement anniv with nationwide tributes
item.description: Bangladesh will observe Martyrs Day and International Mother Language Day on Saturday, commemorating 74 years since the historic Language Movement of 1952.The day honours the students who were killed on February 21, 1952, when police opened fire on demonstrators demanding that Bangla be recognised as a state language of then Pakistan. item.title: Jamaat Ameer pays homage to language martyrs at Shaheed Minar

item.title: BNP pays tributes to language martyrs

item.description: Newly elected independent Member of Parliament Barrister Rumeen Farhana was obstructed from paying tribute to language martyrs at the Central Shaheed Minar in Brahmanbaria's Sarail.The incident happened on the Shaheed Minar premises in Sarail late Friday night (February 21).Protesting the incident, Rumeen's supporters blocked Dhaka-Sylhet highway, causing 10-kilometre long tailback on both sides. item.title: Oman skipper Jatinder finds pride despite winless T20 WC campaign

item.title: Crowds pour into Shaheed Minar
item.description: People from all walks of life thronged at the Central Shaheed Minar to pay tribute to the Language Martyrs.From early Saturday morning, representatives of various political parties, organisations and educational institutions gathered on the Shaheed Minar premise and laid wreaths.
